all: Every class can learn every weapon skill and wear every kind of armor. Weapon masters teach them all, and Dual Wield.
Parachute is taught by every class trainer from level 10. Its cooldown gets shorter as you level, down to 2 min at 80.
Party-wide class auras and buffs reach your whole raid. Healing spells are not changed.
Friendly class buffs that lasted 10 or 30 minutes now last 1 hour.
Class spells can be learned automatically when you level up (turn it on from the spellbook).
Heritage lets you take another race's racial traits, plus one extra racial from a race that is not in the game.

7: Totemic Recall is trained at level 10.
9: Soul Shards stack to 99, and a soul bag may give back the Soul Shard, Infernal Stone or Demonic Figurine a spell used.
Ritual of Doom needs the caster and 2 helpers, and no one is sacrificed.
11: Tranquility heals the 5 raid members with the lowest health.

spells.Tranquility: Heals the 5 raid members with the lowest health, anywhere in the raid.
